title: Withdraw (spike) a published Story and restore it: stories withdraw / stories restore
description: Ryan (via the Anthus news desk editing session, 2026-11-09): no way today to take a published Story down properly. 'papyrus stories move --stage spiked' is board-only (the live page stays up); 'papyrus ops content unpublish' deletes the PublishedItem and sets the Item back to stage copywriting, with no path plan and the old URL then 404s. Need: a CLI/MCP action to WITHDRAW (spike) a published Story so the live page, .md twin, index/section/home/sitemap entries are removed, stage = spiked, old URL -> the site's 404 page or a redirect to its section where the redirect mechanism allows, REVERSIBLE (restore republishes the last published version), with a dry-run printing the exact paths to be written and purged (cap 25, count and cost printed, per the refresh guardrails). Ryan approved spiking 11 MoM stories; nothing is spiked until this exists.
